topics.topic: Handling successful output values that exceed stored_value_bytes_max
questions: When a mapped node's assembled value list is too large, is a new NodeExecution or other failure record written, or is the failure only derived from the element records and the ceiling?
What happens when a successful trial or admission execution returns a value output that is within the contract's `output_bytes` bound but exceeds `stored_value_bytes_max`?

quotes: advance_run: [BEHAVIOR] When nothing can execute: if any element waits, the run rests awaiting_approval when one waits with reason owner_approval, otherwise pending, with one WaitingPoint per waiting element; if nothing waits, the run ends succeeded when every node concluded succeeded or skipped_by_guard and failed otherwise, a mapped node whose delivered value list is over the stored value ceiling counting as failed by the same derivation, with no record of its own, with ended_at set and no waiting points. The final change carries the produced flow outputs as PortRefs; after a change that ends the run succeeded or refused MUST call remove_run_spool for the run and ignore its StoreInternalError.

execute_trial_case: [BEHAVIOR] The outcome is the sandbox outcome of the same name; a succeeded execution is passed when the case has no expected outputs or every output's digest equals the expected one, a many file output equal only with the same length and equal digests position by position, and output_mismatch otherwise; a succeeded value output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant makes the outcome contract_violation.

execute_trial_case: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] For passed and output_mismatch the outputs are recorded, a value as a StoredValue stored with put_value_bytes and a file by digest, size and media type only as a FileFactsRef whose disclosure_class is the highest class of the case's inputs, every output taking that class; other outcomes record outputs None; one RecordTrialExecutionChange is written through record_change with resources_used, the sandbox's detail_code (value_too_large for an output over the stored value ceiling), the sandbox's failure_detail, executed_at from kernel_now and the given actor.
judgement.why: State 8 specifies that an oversized assembled mapped list is a derived failure with no record of its own, while an oversized successful trial or admission value becomes contract_violation with value_too_large and no outputs.

topics.topic: Contract-version and activation updates when admitting an older implementation
questions: If the submitted implementation belongs to an older, non-current contract version of the slot, which contract version's activation is checked and changed, and does the slot's current contract version change?

topics.topic: Handling standing-grant requests for function nodes without an effect class
questions: What happens when the owner requests a standing grant for a function node, which has no effect class?

topics.topic: Handoff of effect outputs and file references to runs without exposing raw effect records
questions: How does runs obtain the output value and file references written by effects so that it can deliver them downstream without reading effects-owned raw NodeExecution records?

topics.topic: Request and kernel behavior when run-spool removal fails
questions: When `capability:store.remove_run_spool` fails after a run ends or is released, does the request still succeed with cleanup deferred to startup, or return `internal_error` and stop the kernel?

topics.topic: Startup recovery behavior for unfinished runs that contain waiting states
questions: During startup recovery, must the kernel execute all ready work in every unfinished run even when that run also has an approval or unknown-outcome wait, or does it advance only runs whose derived status is `running`?

topics.topic: Whether draft-write effects require approval preview or a standing grant
questions: Does the stated successful outcome also allow a `draft-write` to be sent under the run's FlowActivation without an approval preview or standing grant?
